Most covalent compounds have ……2…… electrical conductivity.

intelligence.enrichment: A change is reversible when the original object or substance can be brought back in the form it started with. If the starting form can be recovered, the change is classified as reversible; if it cannot be recovered, it is classified as not reversible. The learner classifies a change as reversible only when the original object or substance can be brought back in its starting form. Once something changes, it is permanent unless it simply looks unchanged by itself.
